description: Minimal implementation and rendered verification for one atomic UI owner or tightly bounded visual defect.

stages.purpose: Inspect the owning component/token and apply the smallest reversible change without widening scope.

gates.require: changed owner is explicit and preserve/forbidden constraints are respected

stages.purpose: Verify the changed owner in its representative rendered state and check nearby regression risk only.

gates.require: changed UI is visually inspected and no adjacent regression is observed
verified versus unverified areas are explicit; completion claims do not exceed evidence
an authorized human decision owner reviews unresolved risk and rollback/learning readiness before production release when project policy requires it
post-launch signals, review cadence and rollback criteria are explicit for the affected owner

policies.reason: Micro rendered QA failed; return to the owning implementation without widening scope.
The assumed owner was wrong; re-inspect project context in implementation before another edit.
Risk exceeded the micro lane; add production verification specialists without silently expanding product scope.
Diagnose tool failure instead of retrying blindly.
Blocked atomic work needs scope/owner re-evaluation before mutation.
